svg.title: Potential, electric field and cumulative energy from fields.csv
svg.desc: Same radii and dielectric inputs as fields.csv. Solid middle clamped voltage, dashed neutral floating middle. Metal interval is shaded; radial field may jump at conductor surfaces.
svg.text: Same electrostatic geometry: clamped vs neutral floating middle conductor
epsilon_r=2/4; U1/U2/U3=1/0.25/0 V; end Neumann condition
solid: specified U2; dashed: Q2 = 0; grey band: middle metal, E = 0
Separate lines stop at each material/metal boundary; no finite-thickness transition is implied.
